LanguageData.LP_BankVault.label: bank
LanguageData.LP_BankVault.description:
Two reinforced glass-windowed vaults that hold only silver and gold, 20 stacks per cell, 80 stacks in total.

Money stored inside can still be used for trade, construction and recipes without taking it out first. The stored silver and gold is visible through the glass and piles higher the more you store; hovering or selecting shows the totals and value of silver and gold, and the "vault ledger" lets you forbid or take out each stack.

The vault never catches fire, and explosions cannot hurt the money inside; when deconstructed, the money stays in place. Orbital trade still requires the bank to be within range of an orbital trade beacon.
